title: Replication package for "Oil Price Shocks, Fiscal Balance, and Public Investment in Ecuador, 2015-2025"

creators.name: Urquiza-Aguiar, Luis
creators.affiliation: Universidad de las Américas (UDLA), Quito, Ecuador

description:
Data and R Markdown code reproducing every table, figure and statistic reported in the article Oil Price Shocks, Fiscal Balance, and Public Investment in Ecuador, 2015-2025.

The package contains the monthly analysis dataset for Ecuador (January 2015 - November 2025, 131 observations) covering the WTI crude oil spot price and Non-Financial Public Sector investment and overall fiscal balance; the complete analysis document, which estimates a VAR with impulse response functions, forecast error variance decomposition, sub-period and lag-order sensitivity models, and symmetric and asymmetric Local Projections with Newey-West HAC standard errors; the knitted PDF showing the expected output; and the Central Bank of Ecuador bulletin table that backs the oil-revenue share reported in the introduction.

Knitting the analysis document in full, in a single R session, reproduces the published tables and figures exactly. Data sources are the U.S. Energy Information Administration (WTI) and the Central Bank of Ecuador, Boletín de Información Estadística Mensual: Table 2.2.1 for the monthly fiscal series, and Table 2.2 for the oil-revenue share reported in the introduction.
notes: Code is released under the MIT License. The data files are redistributed from public sources (U.S. Energy Information Administration; Banco Central del Ecuador) and should be cited as documented in the README. BCE series are subject to later revision; this package fixes the vintage used in the article.
